result.justification: The study provides stated research objectives and a general description of methodologies, but lacks detailed connections between the research question and methods employed.

evidence.quote: We here leverage the use of an SINV strain engineered to express a green fluorescent protein (SINV-GFP) as the basis for a high-content imaging, high-throughput screening (HTS) assay.
The concentration of infectious viral particles for each virus stock was determined using a standard plaque assay on Vero E6 cells.
